Mojtaba Javan <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Sydney,Thanks for the clarification. answer_id: This metadata is simply the ID of the answers you define for Single Answer and Multiple Answer questions. For other types of questions, it'll be "null". We might remove it for other question types in the future. unanswered_status_id: If a question is unanswered, you can find the reason behind it using this metadata. This is the same as what you see in the responses table on your researcher dashboard. This is how the texts in the responses table map to the status IDs in the exported CSV: - "Unanswered - Due to unknown reason" = -1 - "Unanswered - Skipped" = 1 - "Unanswered - Due to question criteria" = 2 - "Unanswered - Due to section criteria" = 3 - "Unanswered - Due to question randomization" = 4 - "Unanswered - Due to section randomization" = 5 - "Unanswered - Due to disabled question" = 6 - "Unanswered - Due to zero section loop" = 7 - "Unanswered - Due to sections flow" = 8 - "Unanswered - Due to session status" = 9 Also, "null" for this metadata means that your question already has a response.You can learn more about what these mean at the end of this section: https://learn.avicennaresearch.com/reference/survey/view-responses#activity-responses-page We will update our Learn and include the IDs too.Please let me know if there's still something unclear. Best regards,Mojtaba Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25791/afc136dcad6b7aa3 --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: support@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Monday, October 14, 2024 at 7:48:07 PM,
